snippet.title: DoodleBob and the Magic Pencil DX Trailer
snippet.description:
DOWNLOAD IN DESCRIPTION!
In 2008, I made DoodleBob and the Magic Pencil for my brother Austin's 10th birthday. It was a decently fun game, but it looked pretty sloppy. The announcement of SpongeBob: Battle for Bikini Bottom inspired me to finally remaster this old pile of barnacles. This "Doodler's Cut" what the game would have looked like if I'd put a little more time and thought into it in the first place.

Changes from the original:
-Better graphics!
-16:9 widescreen instead of 4:3! 
-Increased difficulty!
-Other stuff!

Download: 
http://ethanwakegames.com/

Special thanks to Austin Wake for voicing Plankton in this trailer!
